note: Barclays' everyday current account (sold as the Barclays Bank Account; Flexible in its Fee Information Document) has no monthly fee. Read again 2026-10-30 (the Fee Information Document is still the June 2024 edition): an unarranged overdraft is "Service not available", so a payment past the balance is refused (overdraft false) and refusing it costs nothing; an arranged overdraft is a separate application at 35.0% a year above a £15 interest-free buffer, which the game doesn't hold; cash in pounds in the UK costs nothing at any machine; spending or withdrawing in another currency carries the 2.99% Non-Sterling Transaction fee; a Faster Payment at home and a Barclays International Payment sent online cost nothing (overseas delivery charges by the receiving country may apply and aren't held). Not stated: interest on the account, what opening asks, a savings account.
